name: Cold Iron
author: Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles); interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: Your good axe has gone missing, and maybe the piskeys stole it. A short folk tale. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles), 2011). Non-commercial licence. Type if-cold-iron in the Terminal or tap the icon.

descriptions.en: Your good axe has gone missing, and maybe the piskeys stole it. A short folk tale. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles), 2011). Non-commercial licence. Type if-cold-iron in the Terminal or tap the icon.
descriptions.it: La tua ascia è sparita e forse l'hanno rubata i folletti. Una breve fiaba popolare. Avventura testuale in inglese (Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles), 2011). Licenza non commerciale. Scrivi if-cold-iron nel Terminale o tocca l'icona.
